Liiga standings

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_standings.Rd

Standings of a season: regular season, playoffs, preseason, playout and qualifications tables.

Usage

liiga_standings(season = NULL)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). Omitted = the season in progress.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (49 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
tournamentcharacterTable the row belongs to, in the request vocabulary: runkosarja, playoffs, valmistavat_ottelut, playout or qualifications.
internal_idintegerTeam id (same number as team_id).
team_idintegerTeam id, the number of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key (sent as that string, a bare integer or a digit string depending on the route).
team_slugcharacterTeam slug, the part of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key after the colon (e.g. hpk).
team_namecharacterTeam's display name, e.g. HPK or Tappara.
team_logos_dark_bgcharacterLogo image URL for dark backgrounds.
team_logos_light_bgcharacterLogo image URL for light backgrounds.
team_logos_dark_bg_originalcharacterOriginal-file logo URL for dark backgrounds; null in every capture.
team_logos_light_bg_originalcharacterOriginal-file logo URL for light backgrounds; null in every capture.
rankingintegerTable position.
live_rankingintegerTable position counting games in progress.
gamesintegerGames (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
live_gamesintegerGames counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
winsintegerWins (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
live_winsintegerWins counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
overtime_winsintegerOvertime wins (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
lossesintegerLosses (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
live_lossesintegerLosses counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
tiesintegerTies (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
live_tiesintegerTies counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
overtime_lossesintegerOvertime losses (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
pointsintegerPoints (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
live_pointsintegerPoints counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
goalsintegerGoals (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
goals_againstintegerGoals against (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
live_goalsintegerGoals counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
live_goals_againstintegerGoals against counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
power_play_instancesintegerPower play instances (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
power_play_timeintegerSeconds on the power play, season to date.
power_play_goalsintegerPower play goals (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
short_handed_instancesintegerShort handed instances (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
short_handed_timeintegerSeconds short-handed, season to date.
short_handed_goals_againstintegerShort handed goals against (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
penalty_minutesintegerPenalty minutes (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
two_minute_penaltiesintegerTwo minute penalties (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
five_minute_penaltiesintegerFive minute penalties (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
ten_minute_penaltiesintegerTen minute penalties (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
twenty_minute_penaltiesintegerTwenty minute penalties (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
twenty_five_minute_penaltiesintegerTwenty five minute penalties (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
total_penaltiesintegerTotal penalties (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
distancenumericDistance (team, season to date in that table's tournament). Distance; unit not stated (unverified).
seriecharacterTournament code, uppercase (RUNKOSARJA, PLAYOFFS, PRACTICE, ...); in /schedule the integer tournament id instead (see serieId and Divergence notes).
live_points_per_gamenumericPoints per game counting games in progress (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
power_play_percentagenumericPower-play conversion, a 0-1 FRACTION sent as a STRING (e.g. "0.277"), season to date.
short_handed_percentagenumericPenalty-kill success, a 0-1 FRACTION sent as a STRING (e.g. "0.815"), season to date.
distance_per_gamenumericDistance per game (team, season to date in that table's tournament). Distance; unit not stated (unverified).
points_per_gamenumericPoints per game (team, season to date in that table's tournament).
win_percentagenumericShare of games won, a 0-1 FRACTION sent as a STRING (e.g. "0.583"), season to date.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/standings/

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.
